summary: Masonglory Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting shareholder approval at an extraordinary general meeting held July 31, 2026. Shareholders approved an 8-for-1 share consolidation and a reclassification of authorized capital into Class A and Class B shares, with Class B shares carrying 50 votes each. 62.29% of outstanding shares were represented. The changes are to take effect by August 31, 2026. This is a routine capital reorganization and governance matter, not a special situation such as an acquisition, tender offer, or restructuring.
